objective: Independently attack the new production public OMP worker-response boundary and prove actual CW-10 probes no longer rely on provider private state.
required_attacks: Strict full-frame parsing: missing/multiple marker, prose prefix/suffix, two JSON values, truncated JSON, duplicate/unknown key, wrong stage/kind/decision/identity, bool/float/negative/unsafe integer, malformed UUID.

Terminal causality: response without processed, processed without response, mismatched response ID, wrong role/session/generation, cursor-old event, inverse sequence, duplicate/replayed arm/observe, continuation, retry/additional provider request, tool/error/abort/session switch/pause/disconnect.
Privacy: malformed/prose/thinking/error secret sentinels never appear in public frames or durable artifacts.
Actual OMP 18.2.10 two-stage flow uses exported production G3WorkerResponsePort only; static and runtime proof that workflow probes do not read provider private response dictionaries.
constraints: Do not modify product code, existing tests, docs, workflow artifacts, dependencies, or unrelated files.
Use apply_patch for any independent test files. If a product defect appears, preserve failing evidence and report needs_reroute; do not fix it.
No commit/push/merge/stash/reset/clean. Run graphify update . only if test files are added/changed and report generated drift separately.
checks: New independent tests plus full Node bridge, workflow, bridge, G3, tasks, terminal suites; actual OMP probes; git diff --check; residue/privacy scans.
report: snapshot/scope audit and candidate_ready or needs_reroute
